title: fix(app-shell): the remediation overlay offers Stop impersonating on an impersonation session (objectui#13208)
body:
Fixes #13208

Clause-②: no

## What changes

On an impersonation session (the session carries `impersonatedBy`), the remediation overlay no longer offers the held user's credential forms to the administrator. It says the user has to change their password, or set up two-factor authentication, themselves; it offers **Stop impersonating**; and it keeps **Sign out instead**. On an ordinary session the overlay is unchanged, and it still appears for every posture the server reports. This is item 6 of ruling E on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24762 (comment 6288774214); the server half, B1, is the objectstack services lane's and nothing here waits on it.

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/useImpersonationExit.ts` (new, internal: not on `layout/index.ts`, not on the package entry). The banner's stop logic, moved rather than copied: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/stop-impersonating` over `createAuthenticatedFetch` (which adopts the restored `set-auth-token`), then `refreshSession()`, the failure toast, and the outcome (`stopError`, `notRestored`, `restored`) read from the re-resolved session.
- `ImpersonationBanner.tsx` renders from the hook. Its markup, copy and test ids are unchanged.
- `RemediationOverlay.tsx` gains a third face, `ImpersonationExitPanel`. It is chosen when the session is impersonated, and also while a stop it started is in flight or has restored the administrator, so the administrator is never shown the held user's form in the moment between the session dropping `impersonatedBy` and the gate clearing. On `restored` the overlay clears the gate and reloads, as its two other success paths do. A rejected stop, and a stop that restores nobody, keep the overlay up and say so with the banner's own strings. The server's `message` is not shown on this face: it is written to the held user.
- Copy: `auth.remediation.impersonation.passwordTitle`, `mfaTitle` and `body`, translated in all ten packs (the namespace's parity test pins the key sets and that the prose is not English outside `en`). The button and failure lines reuse `impersonation.banner.stop`, `stopping`, `stopFailed` and `notRestored`: the same action with the same outcomes.
- No server change, no new package export, no new prop.

## Also repaired, because the extraction moved it: a stop's outcome now answers only for the session it was made from

Measured on base `ab4e4d7` before any edit: a new banner pin, "a LATER impersonation, after a stop that worked, is not reported as a failed stop", went red. After a stop that worked, impersonating someone else without a reload (the Impersonate User action refreshes data; it does not reload the page) showed `impersonation-not-restored` ("The server accepted the request but did not restore your administrator session ...") on a session nobody had tried to stop. The banner's attempted flag was never tied to a session. The hook now records the session token a stop was made from, and `stopError` and `notRestored` answer only while the session still holds that token. It sits on the claim's file surface (the banner's stop logic and the tests beside it), in the same gate family, on no file another claim holds.

## Evidence (head `f9951e6`)

Tests, repo-root form, through the shared verify lock:

- The banner test, the objectui#12365 overlay test and the new `RemediationOverlay.impersonation-13208.test.tsx`: 3 files, 14 tests passed.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/`, the product-neutral ratchet, and the eight `apps/console` tests that name `ConsoleShell`: 162 files, 1112 tests passed.
- `packages/i18n/` (every locale parity test): 84 files, 1319 passed, 13 skipped.

The new overlay pins run on the real `AuthProvider`, with identity resolved from the stored token the way the server resolves it, and the gate raised by a 403 policy body coming back through `createAuthenticatedFetch`. PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED and MFA_REQUIRED each show Stop and no credential form. Stop sends the impersonated bearer, adopts the administrator token, clears the gate and reloads once, and the change-password form is never added to the document on the way. A stop that is accepted but restores nobody, and a rejected stop, keep the overlay, say why, and do not reload. An ordinary session still gets its own password form and no Stop.

Ablations, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on the committed head, restore proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subjects are imported by relative path, so there is no `dist/` leg.

1. Overlay face off (`const impersonating = false;`): 5 failed, 1 passed. Every impersonation case is red; the ordinary-session case stays green.
2. The hold dropped (`Boolean(exit.impersonatedBy)` alone): 1 failed, 5 passed. The Stop case is red, "expected true to be false" on the form watch.
3. The outcome untied from its session: the banner re-impersonation pin is red, 1 failed, 11 passed. The first attempt used the bare word `finished` as the replacement; the tool refused it because that word already occurs in the file, so nothing ran. It was re-run with a marker comment as the replacement.

Local gates, all exit 0: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`; the test config does include the new test, since an earlier TS2345 in it was reported from there), `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`. Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Reaching it in a browser

On a stock showcase backend (`--seed-admin`): Setup, Users, a user's **Set Password** action with **Require Password Change On Next Login** left on (the default; **Create User** with **Require Password Change On First Login** does the same), then that user's **Impersonate User** action, confirmed. The next data request comes back `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` and raises the overlay. Selectors: the overlay face `[data-testid="remediation-impersonation-exit"]`, its Stop `[data-testid="remediation-impersonation-stop"]`, its failure lines `remediation-impersonation-stop-error` and `remediation-impersonation-not-restored`; the banner `[data-testid="impersonation-banner"]` and its Stop `[data-testid="impersonation-stop"]`.

## Acceptance notes

- No README or `content/docs` page describes the remediation overlay or the impersonation banner today, and none was added: docs are outside the claim's file surface. Carrier: none.
- Read only, not measured: after a stop from the banner (no overlay up), the page is not reloaded, so data fetched as the impersonated user stays on screen until it is refetched. The overlay path reloads. Carrier: none.

Changeset: `.changeset/13208-overlay-stop-impersonating.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch).
